safety_tips.tip: Beware of tuk-tuk and taxi scams: drivers offering special tours or refusing the meter may take you to shops where you are pressured to buy
Beware of gem and jewelry scams offering special deals on overpriced or fake gemstones
Beware of people claiming the Grand Palace or other temples are closed today and redirecting you to shops or other attractions
Street touts may promise cheap tours or transport, then overcharge or provide substandard service
Pickpocketing and bag snatching happen in crowded markets, BTS/MRT stations and tourist areas
Fake travel agents and ticket sellers may sell invalid bus, train or attraction tickets
Avoid ATM skimming by using machines in banks or secure areas, not ATMs attached to walls
Free or cheap tours offered with timeshare or hotel deals are used to pressure tourists into expensive property deals
Pickpocketing and bag snatching are common in crowded markets, BTS/MRT stations and tourist areas
Pickpocketing can happen in crowded areas, markets and BTS/MRT stations
Use reputable transport: metered taxis, Grab, BTS/MRT or licensed tuk-tuks
Keep cash, passport and cards in a money belt or hidden pouch
Eat street food from busy stalls with high turnover
Avoid isolated areas at night and stick to well-lit, populated streets
Keep local police, embassy and hospital numbers handy
